plain.li: [greetings,warm,tie:grudge:theirs] My people still hold a grudge against {GRUDGEAGAINST}, {WRITER}. I don't, and I wanted you to hear it from me.
[greetings,cordial,tie:grudge:theirs] Thank you for writing. Not everyone here has forgiven what happened to our people in your keeping, but I read your letter with an open mind.
[greetings,cool,tie:grudge:theirs] We read your letter. Some here still say {GRUDGEAGAINST} and our dead in the same breath.
[greetings,curt,tie:grudge:theirs] Our people died as your prisoners. Beyond that, we have nothing to say to {GRUDGEAGAINST}.
[condolences,cool,tie:grudge:theirs] You send sympathy for our losses. The ones of ours who died as your prisoners were losses too.
[warning,cordial,tie:grudge:theirs] We have our grievance with {GRUDGEAGAINST}, but a warning is a warning, and we thank you for it.
[warning,warm,call,tie:grudge:theirs] We have our quarrel with your colony, and still you called to warn us. That will be remembered here.
[news,curt,tie:grudge:theirs] You want our news. Our news is that we have not forgotten our dead.
[invitation,refusal,tie:grudge:theirs] Visit the place where our people died as prisoners? No.
[help,refusal,tie:grudge:theirs] You ask us for {HELP}, with our dead still unanswered for? No.
[greetings,cool,tie:grudge:you] I know you have sworn vengeance on my people, {WRITER}. You will understand if this letter is short.
[greetings,cordial,tie:grudge:ours,!tie:grudge:you] I am told someone in your colony has sworn vengeance on my people. I hope letters like these count for something against it.
[greetings,warm,tie:favour:theirs] Tell {FAVOURFOR} we have not forgotten what they asked of us. It is meant to come with the next of ours who visits.
[greetings,cordial,tie:favour:theirs] Thank you for your letter. And the favor {FAVOURFOR} asked of us has not slipped anyone's mind here.
[greetings,cordial,call,tie:favour:theirs] Good of you to call. Tell {FAVOURFOR} we haven't forgotten what they asked us for.
[news,cordial,tie:favour:theirs] Here is what we hear. Tell {FAVOURFOR} that what they asked of us is still owed and still remembered.
[help,warm,tie:favour:theirs] Of course we send {HELP}. It changes nothing of what we already owe {FAVOURFOR}.
[greetings,warm,tie:promise:theirs] One of ours has promised to speak well of {PROMISEDTO} here. From your letter, I can see why.
[greetings,cordial,tie:promise:theirs] I hear a good word for {PROMISEDTO} is on its way to us. I will listen when it comes.
[invitation,warm,tie:promise:theirs] A good word for {PROMISEDTO} is already on its way here, and now an invitation as well. I will come and see for myself.
[greetings,warm,them:lately:tie:promise:kept] Good words have been spoken of your people here lately, and your letter bears every one of them out.
[invitation,cordial,them:lately:tie:promise:kept] After the good words spoken of your people here lately, I would like to see them for myself.
[greetings,cordial,tie:claim:theirs,!tie:claim:you] Tell {CLAIMON} their family here has not forgotten them.
[greetings,warm,tie:claim:you] Your family here has not forgotten you, {WRITER}. Write to them too, when you can.
[greetings,cool,tie:claim:theirs,!tie:claim:you] Your letter came. Some here would rather {CLAIMON} had written it, and from home.
[condolences,warm,tie:claim:you] Your words mean more coming from you, {WRITER}. You are still one of ours, whatever roof you sleep under.
[invitation,cordial,tie:claim:theirs,!tie:claim:you] I will come, and I would like to see {CLAIMON} while I am there, if they will see me.
[greetings,cordial,tie:claim:due,!tie:claim:you] {CLAIMON}'s family has come to ask them home, as is their right. Whatever your council decides, let it be decided fairly.
[help,refusal,tie:claim:theirs,!tie:claim:you] You keep {CLAIMON} from their family and then ask us for {HELP}? Ask again when that is settled.
[greetings,curt,tie:debt:ours] Your colony owes us silver. A letter is not a payment.
[greetings,cool,tie:debt:due] The silver your colony owes us is due. We would rather have read about that than this.
[news,curt,tie:debt:ours] Here is the news you want: your debt to us has not gone anywhere.
[help,refusal,tie:debt:ours] You already owe us silver, and now you ask for {HELP}? No.
[greetings,warm,tie:fealty:ours,theirLowtech] It is good to hear from those who hold land by our grant. Write often, and tell us how the fields do.
[greetings,cordial,tie:fealty:ours] The land you hold of {FEALTYTO} is in good hands, it seems. Thank you for your letter.
[help,warm,tie:fealty:ours] Those who hold land of {FEALTYTO} do not go without. We send {HELP} gladly.
[help,cordial,tie:fealty:ours] We can spare some {HELP}. Remember whose grant you live on when we are the ones asking.
[invitation,cordial,tie:fealty:ours,theirHightech] I will come and see how our grant is kept, as a guest and not an inspector.
[greetings,cordial,tie:fealty:theirs] One of our towns answers to {FEALTYTO} now. Letters like yours make that easier to bear.
[greetings,curt,tie:fealty:theirs] You hold one of our towns. Do not expect warm letters as well.
[news,cordial,town:lately:world:began] You ask for news. The biggest is at our own gate, and we are still taking it in.
[news,warm,town:lately:world:ended] You ask for our news, and the best of it is that what kept {TOWN} so busy has run its course.
[help,refusal,town:lately:world:began] We are sorry, but with all that has begun here at {TOWN}, we cannot spare {HELP}.
[greetings,cordial,town:lately:world:built] Your letter is among the first to reach {TOWN} since its last roofs went up. It will be kept.
[greetings,cordial,town:lately:world:taken] Since {TOWN} changed hands, it is good to have a letter that asks nothing of us.
[warning,warm,town:lately:world:taken] {TOWN} has only just changed hands, and a warning is worth more to us now than ever. Thank you.
[invitation,cool,town:lately:world:taken] {TOWN} changed hands not long ago. This is no season for visiting.
[greetings,warm,town:lately:world:vassal] {TOWN} answers to your colony now, and your letter is a kind start. We will hold you to that kindness.
[greetings,warm,them:lately:world:built] I founded {TOWN} only lately, and yours is one of the first letters I have had here. Thank you, {WRITER}.
[news,cordial,them:lately:world:began] You ask for news, and some of it is about me, which I did not ask for.
[greetings,cool,them:lately:world:began] I have had little time for letters lately, with my own name in everyone's mouth.
